basic_details.short_information: WAPCOS Limited, a Government of India Undertaking, has released a notice to engage Experts on a project-term basis. WAPCOS describes itself as an ISO 9001:2015, "Mini Ratna-I" organization. The engagement is for work relating to various Power Transmission, Distribution and Solar Projects in India and abroad.

Get the WAPCOS format and further details from the website www.wapcos.co.in. Applications in other formats will be rejected.
Fill in the prescribed proforma and attach self-attested photocopies of documents in support of Date of birth, Qualification, Experience and Proof of category etc.

Get the WAPCOS format and further details from the website www.wapcos.co.in. Applications in other formats will be rejected. Departments/PSU/Autonomous bodies must produce a no objection/relieving certificate at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q1. What is the full form of WAPCOS?
faq.answer: WAPCOS stands for Water and Power Consultancy Services, a premier Public Sector Undertaking under the aegis of the Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India, providing consultancy services globally.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 29 project-based vacancies have been announced under this notification for various technical and non-technical expert positions for domestic and international projects.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for WAPCOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 7 November 2026. Candidates are advised to send their CVs well before the deadline to avoid technical issues.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly via email to the designated address ([email protected]) in the prescribed WAPCOS format along with all mandatory supporting documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the engagement of Consultants across all advertised posts is 67 years as on 1 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for the Transmission Expert post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Transmission Expert position must hold a B.E./B.Tech degree in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university or institution.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for WAPCOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned or required to be paid by candidates submitting their candidature for these project-based consultant openings.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: Selected candidates may be deployed across India or abroad based on project requirements, as WAPCOS undertakes various domestic and international assignments.

faq.question: Q9. What documents need to be attached with the application email?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach the prescribed proforma application form along with self-attested photocopies of certificates supporting date of birth, qualifications, experience, and category proof.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply in any format other than the prescribed one?
faq.answer: No, applications submitted in formats other than the official WAPCOS proforma will be summarily rejected by the recruiting authority.
